finding: Conclusively established the root cause of Package 83 R1's damage healing and apparent history loss: The frozen production UEL f42_mixed_uel.for unconditionally zeroes COMMON-block history arrays SV_H_COMMITTED and SV_H_TRIAL at UEXTERNALDB LOP=0, and attempts to repopulate them from element SVARS(9..12) via a hard-coded gate IF (KSTEP .EQ. 1 .AND. KINC .LE. 1). In Package 83 R1, *RESTART, READ, STEP=1, INC=111, END STEP causes Abaqus execution to begin in Step 2 (KSTEP=2), which completely bypasses the initialization gate. Consequently, COMMON history was zeroed across all 1,600 elements. When the staggered phase solve executed, the missing 2H(1-d) driving source term allowed crack-tip damage to relax downward from 0.9971 to 0.9822 (healing violation). When the mechanical solve ran, current strain energy (57.82 MPa) overwrote SV_H_TRIAL, permanently wiping the authentic peak history of 82.32 MPa and causing a 38.4x stiffness surge that drove RF2 to 6.12 N. Existing raw solver evidence from Job 1416405 (Frame 0 vs Frame 1) and Job 1416392 proves this mechanism without requiring redundant HPC submissions. A candidate restart-aware state restoration architecture using element-level lazy initialization has been formulated and verified in diagnostic subroutine f42_mixed_uel_restart_aware.for, while the production UEL remains 100% bitwise frozen pending formal review.
